name: Enterprise System Integration
summary: An anonymized integration-testing case study focused on validating data movement and processing across connected enterprise services.
challenge: Multiple services and downstream systems exchange business data. A failure at one stage can affect the completeness or consistency of records further along the flow.
approach: Map the end-to-end flow, identify validation points, prepare positive and negative test data, and verify processing results at the API, database, and log levels.
responsibilities: Validate API responses and database records

name: Trade Finance Quality Assurance
summary: An anonymized banking case study covering business-flow test distribution, SIT/UAT coordination, evidence validation, and defect follow-up for Trade Finance processes.
challenge: Trade Finance workflows contain multiple business paths and dependencies. Testing requires clear scenario ownership, reliable test data, and consistent evidence review.
approach: Organize test coverage by business flow, coordinate execution, prepare test data, monitor progress, compare environment behavior, and validate evidence against test steps.
responsibilities: Coordinate test case distribution by business flow
Review evidence and record defects in JIRA
Communicate progress, blockers, and follow-up actions

name: API & Data Validation
summary: A practical API-testing case study demonstrating request validation, reusable assertions, database checks, and execution reporting.
challenge: API integrations need predictable validation for required fields, business rules, response structure, and the resulting data state.
approach: Design one request per scenario, prepare valid and invalid payloads, add assertions for status and response content, and reconcile results with database records where applicable.
responsibilities: Write JavaScript assertions for expected results
Prepare positive, negative, and boundary test data
Review execution output and document failures
